E.2.b.

I do not think that the writer of the attached article can be identical with the subject of this file. However, as you know the case so well, I would be grateful for your views. The article appeared in the July 1944 issue of "War Commentary" which is a very subversive and anti-war publication of the Freedom Press Anarchists.

F.3.b.
23.10.44.

M. R. Sercombe.
